hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] || exit 0; export PATH="$(go env GOPATH)/bin:$PATH"; if [ -d "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/cmd/anvil" ]; then (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && go install -ldflags "-X github.com/chonalchendo/anvil/internal/cli.Version=cloud-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" ./cmd/anvil); else go install github.com/chonalchendo/anvil/cmd/anvil@latest; fi; anvil install cloud --json | jq -e '.provisioned' > /dev/null && anvil install fire-session-start
[ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ] || exit 0; export PATH="$(go env GOPATH)/bin:$PATH"; anvil session end --commit --push
